name: Projectivy Launcher
hint: In Projectivy: Settings → Backup & restore → Export settings — save the .plbackup file with the file picker (Downloads is typical). Then find it here and copy it off the TV.

name: SmartTube
hint: In SmartTube: Settings → Backup/Restore → Local backup. Current releases save the ZIP in Documents/SmartTubeBackup; the file is named after the build (org.smarttube.stable_….zip).

name: SmartTube Beta
hint: In SmartTube Beta: Settings → Backup/Restore → Local backup. Same export location as the stable build.
